# @three-blocks/pro

High-performance Web Worker physics engine for Three.js WebGPU with SharedArrayBuffer communication.

## Features

- **Worker-based simulation** - 60Hz physics loop in a dedicated Web Worker
- **Lock-free SharedArrayBuffer** - Zero-copy state synchronization between threads
- **Capsule-trimesh collision** - BVH-accelerated collision detection
- **Character controller** - Jumping, sliding, orbital gravity, flying modes
- **Physics models** - Built-in presets (Arcade, Platformer, Realistic) with custom preset support
- **Camera systems** - FirstPersonCamera, ThirdPersonCamera classes extending PerspectiveCamera
- **Trigger zones** - Enter/exit events without collision response
- **Interpolation** - Smooth rendering between physics frames via `syncPhysics`
- **Kinematic animations** - anime.js-powered platform animations with `KinematicAnimator`

## Quick Start

```javascript
import { Physics, PhysicsController, BodyType, syncPhysics } from '@three-blocks/pro';

// 1. Create and initialize physics
const physics = new Physics({ gravity: -9.81 });
await physics.init();

// 2. Add ground collision
await physics.addBody(BodyType.STATIC, groundMesh, { friction: 1 });

// 3. Add player
// Position the mesh first
playerMesh.position.set(0, 5, 0);

await physics.addBody(BodyType.DYNAMIC, playerMesh, { mass: 1.5 }, {
  capsuleRadius: 0.5,
  capsuleLength: 1,
});

// 4. Start simulation
await physics.start();

// 5. Create controller with input handling
const controller = new PhysicsController(physics);

// 6. Game loop
function animate(delta) {
  controller.update(delta);

  // Sync mesh with physics (unified API for all body types)
  const alpha = controller.getInterpolationAlpha();
  syncPhysics(physics.player, playerMesh, alpha);

  renderer.render(scene, camera);
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
}
animate();
```

## Architecture

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                      MAIN THREAD                         │
│                                                          │
│   Physics ──────► SharedArrayBuffer ◄────── Renderer │
│       │                    │                      │      │
│   PhysicsController ◄──────┘                      │      │
│       │                                           │      │
│   InputController ────────────────────────────────┘      │
└──────────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────┘
                           │ Comlink RPC
                           ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                   PHYSICS WORKER (60 FPS)                │
│                                                          │
│   Physics Loop ──► Collision ──► Movement ──► Camera    │
│        │                                                 │
│   SharedArrayBuffer (writes position/quaternion/state)  │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Core API

### Physics

Main thread facade for the physics engine.

```javascript
const physics = new Physics({
  gravity: -9.81,           // Gravity scalar
  linearDrag: 1,            // Linear drag coefficient
  maxDynamicBodies: 16,     // Player/character bodies
  maxKinematicBodies: 256,  // Moving platforms
  maxStaticBodies: 512,     // World geometry
  maxZones: 128,            // Trigger zones
  debug: false,             // Debug mode
  physicsModel: 'arcade',  // 'arcade', 'platformer', 'realistic'
  customPhysicsModel: null, // Custom model object (see Physics Models section)
});

await physics.init();       // Initialize engine
await physics.start();      // Start simulation
physics.pause();            // Pause simulation
physics.resume();           // Resume simulation
await physics.dispose();    // Clean up
```

#### Properties

```javascript
// Direct state access (auto-registered to store)
physics.player              // Main player (dynamic body 0)
physics.cameraState         // Camera state
physics.physicsState        // Global physics state
physics.api                 // Physics API for direct worker calls
physics.info                // Performance metrics and body analytics

// Body management - returns api with body reference
const api = await physics.addBody(type, mesh, properties?, bodyProps?, options?)
api.body.sync(alpha)           // Sync physics to mesh with interpolation
api.body.position.set(x, y, z) // Set position via Three.js-like interface
api.body.view                  // Direct buffer access (advanced)

// Internal body accessors (prefer api.body from addBody)
physics.getStaticMesh(index)   // Get mesh for static body (for debug visualization)
```

#### Input Binding

```javascript
import { InputController } from '@three-blocks/pro';

const input = new InputController({ dispatcher });
physics.bindInput(input, { playerIndex: 0, jumpVelocity: 8 });

// In render loop
physics.updateInput();
```

---

### PhysicsController

High-level controller with interpolation and input handling.

```javascript
const controller = new PhysicsController(physics, {
  enableInput: true,      // Create InputController automatically
  playerBodyIndex: 0,     // Body index for input
  inputOptions: {         // Options for InputController
    dispatcher,
    enableEditorKeys: true,
    enableCameraToggle: true,
  },
});
```

#### Methods

```javascript
controller.update(delta);              // Update all proxies with interpolation
controller.getDynamic(index);          // Get EntityProxy for dynamic body
controller.getKinematic(index);        // Get EntityProxy for kinematic body
controller.applyInput(index, input);   // Apply input to body
controller.setCameraMode(mode);        // 'firstPerson', 'thirdPerson', 'birdView'
controller.setCameraDrag(dx, dy);      // Camera drag input
controller.pause();
controller.resume();
controller.dispose();
```

#### EntityProxy

```javascript
const player = controller.getDynamic(0);

// Interpolated transforms
player.position     // THREE.Vector3
player.quaternion   // THREE.Quaternion
player.velocity     // THREE.Vector3

// State flags (read-only)
player.grounded     // boolean
player.jumping      // boolean
player.falling      // boolean
player.sliding      // boolean

// Writable properties
player.mass = 2.0;
player.friction = 0.5;
player.sleeping = false;

// Methods
player.teleport([0, 10, 0]);
player.applyTo(mesh);  // Copy transform to mesh
```

---

### InputController

Pure input state tracking for keyboard/gamepad.

```javascript
const input = new InputController({
  element: window,              // Event target
  dispatcher: null,             // For offscreen canvas
  enableEditorKeys: true,       // Period, comma, slash keys
  enableCameraToggle: true,     // V key
  onToggleCamera: () => {},     // Callbacks
  onTogglePause: () => {},
});

// Query state
const { x, y, jump } = input.getInput();
input.isPressed('forward');

// Gamepad support
input.setAnalogInput(stick.x, stick.y, buttonA, 0.2);

input.dispose();
```

**Default Key Mappings:**
| Action | Keys |
|--------|------|
| Forward | W, ArrowUp, I, Numpad8 |
| Backward | S, ArrowDown, K, Numpad5 |
| Left | A, ArrowLeft, J, Numpad4 |
| Right | D, ArrowRight, L, Numpad6 |
| Jump | Space |
| Camera | V |
| Pause | / |
| Editor | . |
| Orbit | , |

## Physics Models

Physics models control how characters move and feel. They define force multipliers, gravity behavior, friction, and jump mechanics to create different gameplay styles.

### How It Works

The physics model system uses a callback-based architecture where each model implements these core functions:

| Function | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| `getForceMultiplier(state)` | Movement force based on grounded/air state |
| `getGravityBonus(state)` | Additional gravity during jumps/falls |
| `getFriction(state, baseFriction)` | Surface friction modifier |
| `getJumpVelocity(state)` | Initial jump velocity |
| `applyAirControl(velocity, wishDir, delta)` | Optional: Custom air strafing logic |
| `applySurfacePhysics(velocity, surfaceNormal, slopeAngle, wishDir, delta, bodyState)` | Optional: Custom surface/ramp physics |

The `state` object contains: `grounded`, `jumping`, `falling`, `localVelocity`, `surfaceNormal`, `slopeAngle`.

### Built-in Presets

| Preset | Description | Air Control | Gravity Bonus | Best For |
|--------|-------------|-------------|---------------|----------|
| `arcade` | Balanced, responsive | 3x (reduced) | Fast fall (-15) | General games |
| `platformer` | Platformer-style | 2x (minimal) | Very fast fall (-20) | Platformers |
| `realistic` | Minimal air control | 0.5x | Linear (-12) | Simulation |

### Selecting a Preset

```javascript
import { Physics } from '@three-blocks/pro';

// Use a built-in preset
const physics = new Physics({
  gravity: -20,
  physicsModel: 'platformer',  // 'arcade', 'platformer', 'realistic'
});

await physics.init();
await physics.start();
```

### Creating Custom Presets

Use `extendPreset()` to create custom physics models based on existing presets:

```javascript
import { Physics, extendPreset, ArcadeModel } from '@three-blocks/pro';

// Create a custom preset extending Arcade
const HeavyModel = extendPreset(ArcadeModel, {
  name: 'heavy',
  config: {
    ...ArcadeModel.config,
    gravity: 32,        // Heavier gravity
    maxSpeed: 6,        // Slower max speed
    airAccel: 2,        // Limited air control
    jumpVelocity: 7,    // Lower jump
  },
});

// Use custom preset
const physics = new Physics({
  physicsModel: 'custom',
  customPhysicsModel: HeavyModel,
});
```

### Preset Extension Utilities

```javascript
import { extendPreset, scalePreset, combinePresets, PlatformerModel, ArcadeModel } from '@three-blocks/pro';

// extendPreset - Override specific functions
const FastPlatformer = extendPreset(PlatformerModel, {
  name: 'fast-platformer',
  getForceMultiplier(state) {
    return state.grounded ? 18 : 4;  // Faster movement
  },
});

// scalePreset - Scale numeric return values
const LowGravityPlatformer = scalePreset(PlatformerModel, {
  jumpVelocity: 1.3,     // 30% higher jumps
}, 'low-gravity-platformer');

// combinePresets - Blend multiple presets
const HybridModel = combinePresets('hybrid', [
  { preset: PlatformerModel, weight: 0.6 },
  { preset: ArcadeModel, weight: 0.4 },
], ArcadeModel);
```

### Physics Model Interface

For advanced customization, implement the full interface:

```javascript
const CustomModel = {
  name: 'custom',

  /**
   * Get movement force multiplier
   * @param {Object} state - { grounded, jumping, falling, flying, sliding, localVelocity }
   * @returns {number} Force multiplier (higher = faster acceleration)
   */
  getForceMultiplier(state) {
    if (state.grounded) return 12;  // Ground control
    if (state.jumping) return 4;    // Jump control
    return 2;                        // Fall control
  },

  /**
   * Get gravity bonus (added to base gravity)
   * @param {Object} state
   * @returns {number} Gravity modifier (negative = fall faster)
   */
  getGravityBonus(state) {
    if (state.jumping && state.localVelocity.y > 0) return 0;  // Rising
    if (state.falling) return -15;                              // Falling fast
    return -5;
  },

  /**
   * Get friction coefficient
   * @param {Object} state
   * @param {number} baseFriction - Base friction from physics config
   * @returns {number} Final friction value
   */
  getFriction(state, baseFriction) {
    if (state.grounded) return baseFriction;
    if (state.sliding) return 0.05;  // Low sliding friction
    return baseFriction * 0.1;       // Air friction
  },

  /**
   * Get jump velocity
   * @param {Object} state
   * @returns {number} Jump velocity (higher = higher jumps)
   */
  getJumpVelocity(state) {
    return 10;
  },

  /**
   * Optional: Custom air control
   * @param {Object} localVelocity - { x, y, z }
   * @param {Object} wishDir - { x, z } normalized input direction
   * @param {number} delta - Time delta
   * @returns {Object|null} Modified velocity { x, z } or null to skip
   */
  applyAirControl(localVelocity, wishDir, delta) {
    // Return null to use default air physics
    return null;
  },
};
```

### Key Physics Values Reference

| Value | Arcade | Platformer | Realistic | Description |
|-------|--------|------------|-----------|-------------|
| Ground force | 12 | 14 | 10 | Ground acceleration |
| Air force | 3 | 2 | 0.5 | Air acceleration (lower = less floaty) |
| Jump velocity | 10 | 12 | 8 | Initial upward velocity |
| Falling gravity bonus | -15 | -20 | -12 | Extra gravity while falling |
| Air friction | 0.1× | 0.05× | 0.2× | Air friction multiplier |

## Body Types

```javascript
import { BodyType, createWallBox } from '@three-blocks/pro';
```

### Static Bodies
Fixed world geometry (ground, walls, platforms).

```javascript
await physics.addBody(BodyType.STATIC, mesh, { friction: 1 });
```

### Dynamic Bodies
Player/character with full physics.

```javascript
mesh.position.set(0, 5, 0);
await physics.addBody(BodyType.DYNAMIC, mesh, {
  friction: 0.3,
  mass: 1.5,
}, {
  capsuleRadius: 0.5,
  capsuleLength: 1,
});

// Configure after creation
physics.player.forceCapacity = 12;
physics.player.turnCapacity = 3;
physics.player.maxVelocity = 10;
```

### Kinematic Bodies
Animated/scripted bodies (platforms, doors). Use `KinematicAnimator` for anime.js-powered animations.

```javascript
import { KinematicAnimator, BodyType, syncPhysics } from '@three-blocks/pro';

// Create animator
const animator = new KinematicAnimator(physics);

// Add kinematic body
platformMesh.position.set(0, 1, 0);
const api = await physics.addBody(BodyType.KINEMATIC, platformMesh,
  { friction: 1 },
  {}
);
const bodyIndex = api.index;

// Animate with from/to
animator.animate(bodyIndex, {
  position: { from: [0, 1, 0], to: [5, 1, 0] },
  duration: 2000,
  ease: 'inOutQuad',
  loop: true,
  alternate: true,
});

// Or use keyframes for complex paths
animator.keyframes(bodyIndex, {
  px: [
    { to: 0, duration: 0 },
    { to: 5, duration: 1500, ease: 'outQuad' },
    { to: 5, duration: 500 },
    { to: 0, duration: 1500, ease: 'inQuad' },
  ],
  py: [
    { to: 1, duration: 0 },
    { to: 3, duration: 1500, ease: 'outBounce' },
    { to: 3, duration: 500 },
    { to: 1, duration: 1500 },
  ],
}, { loop: true });

// Or use timeline for sequenced animations
const { timeline, target } = animator.createTimelineFor(bodyIndex,
  { loop: true, defaults: { ease: 'inOutQuad' } },
  { px: 0, py: 1, pz: 0, qw: 1 }
);

timeline
  .add(target, { px: 5, duration: 1500 })
  .add(target, { py: 3, duration: 800, ease: 'outBack' })
  .add(target, { px: 0, py: 1, duration: 1000 });

// In render loop - sync all kinematic bodies
const alpha = controller.getInterpolationAlpha();
const state = physics.getKinematicBody(bodyIndex);
syncPhysics(state, platformMesh, alpha);

// Cleanup
animator.dispose();
```

### Zone Triggers
Trigger volumes without collision response.

```javascript
import { BodyEvent } from '@three-blocks/pro';

const zoneApi = await physics.addBody(BodyType.ZONE, mesh);

zoneApi.body.addEventListener(BodyEvent.ZONE_ENTER, () => console.log('Entered zone'));
zoneApi.body.addEventListener(BodyEvent.ZONE_LEAVE, () => console.log('Left zone'));
```

## Camera System

Physics-integrated camera classes that extend `THREE.PerspectiveCamera`. Use directly with `renderer.render(scene, camera)`.

### FirstPersonCamera

FPS camera with automatic pointer lock, mouse look, and body rotation sync.

```javascript
import { Physics, FirstPersonCamera, PhysicsController } from '@three-blocks/pro';

// Create physics and player
const physics = new Physics({ gravity: -9.81 });
await physics.init();
// ... add bodies ...
await physics.start();

// Create first-person camera - extends PerspectiveCamera
const camera = new FirstPersonCamera(physics, {
  canvas: renderer.domElement,  // For pointer lock
  target: playerMesh,           // Body to follow
  eyeHeight: 1.7,               // Height offset from body
  sensitivity: { x: 2, y: 2 },  // Mouse sensitivity
  pitchLimits: [-85, 85],       // Vertical look limits (degrees)
  fov: 70,                      // Field of view
  near: 0.1,                    // Near clipping plane
  far: 1000,                    // Far clipping plane
});

// Listen for pointer lock events
camera.on('lock', () => console.log('FPS mode active'));
camera.on('unlock', () => console.log('Pointer released'));

// Create controller for input
const controller = new PhysicsController(physics, { enableInput: true });

// Game loop - camera IS a PerspectiveCamera
function animate() {
  const delta = clock.getDelta();

  // Get input and apply to physics
  const input = controller.input.getInput();
  controller.applyInput(0, {
    x: input.x,
    y: input.y,
    jump: input.jump,
    // Note: Don't pass 'look' - FirstPersonCamera handles body rotation internally
  });
  controller.update(delta);

  // Sync player mesh
  syncPhysics(physics.player, playerMesh, controller.getInterpolationAlpha());

  // Update camera and render (camera handles body rotation in update())
  camera.update(delta);
  renderer.render(scene, camera);  // Use directly!
}

// Cleanup
camera.dispose();
```

**FirstPersonCamera API:**

| Property/Method | Description |
|-----------------|-------------|
| `eyeHeight` | Height offset from target body |
| `sensitivity` | `{ x, y }` mouse sensitivity |
| `pitchLimits` | `[min, max]` vertical look limits in degrees |
| `yaw` | Current yaw rotation (radians) |
| `pitch` | Current pitch rotation (radians) |
| `isLocked` | Whether pointer lock is active |
| `lock()` | Request pointer lock |
| `unlock()` | Exit pointer lock |
| `on(event, callback)` | Listen for 'lock' or 'unlock' events |
| `update(delta)` | Update camera (call each frame) |
| `resize(width?, height?)` | Handle window resize |
| `dispose()` | Clean up event listeners |

### ThirdPersonCamera

Third-person camera with orbit controls and collision avoidance. *(Coming soon)*

```javascript
import { ThirdPersonCamera } from '@three-blocks/pro';

const camera = new ThirdPersonCamera(physics, {
  target: playerMesh,
  offset: { x: 0, y: 2, z: -5 },
  collisionLayers: ['static'],
});
```

### PhysicsCamera (Base Class)

Abstract base class for physics-integrated cameras. Extend to create custom camera types.

```javascript
import { PhysicsCamera } from '@three-blocks/pro';

class MyCamera extends PhysicsCamera {
  constructor(physics, options) {
    super(physics, options);
    // Custom initialization
  }

  update(delta) {
    // Sync from physics worker
    this._syncFromWorker();
    // Custom camera logic
  }
}
```

### Legacy Camera API

For advanced control, you can still access camera state directly:

```javascript
// Set via controller
controller.setCameraMode('thirdPerson');
controller.setCameraMode('firstPerson');
controller.setCameraMode('birdView');

// Or directly on camera state
physics.cameraState.lockRotation = 1;  // Tank-style controls
physics.cameraState.firstPerson = 1;
physics.cameraState.birdView = 1;
physics.cameraState.aimMode = 1;       // Strafe mode

// Camera offsets
physics.cameraState.cameraOffsetx = 0;
physics.cameraState.cameraOffsety = 2;
physics.cameraState.cameraOffsetz = -5;

// Sync Three.js camera manually
const cam = physics.cameraState;
camera.position.set(cam.positionx, cam.positiony, cam.positionz);
camera.quaternion.set(cam.quaternionx, cam.quaterniony, cam.quaternionz, cam.quaternionw);
```

## Body Events

Body events use the Three.js EventDispatcher pattern directly on body instances:

```javascript
import { BodyEvent } from '@three-blocks/pro';

// Collision events
api.body.addEventListener(BodyEvent.COLLIDE, (event) => {});
api.body.addEventListener(BodyEvent.COLLIDE_END, () => {});

// Hit events (rayshoot/hitscan)
api.body.addEventListener(BodyEvent.HIT, (event) => {
  console.log('Hit at:', event.hitPoint);
});

// Zone events (on zone bodies)
zoneApi.body.addEventListener(BodyEvent.ZONE_ENTER, () => {});
zoneApi.body.addEventListener(BodyEvent.ZONE_LEAVE, () => {});

// Pointer events
groundApi.body.addEventListener(BodyEvent.POINTER_INTERSECT, (event) => {
  const { colliders, isClick } = event;
  if (isClick) console.log('Clicked at:', colliders[0].point);
});

// Input events (via event emitter)
import { onEvent } from '@three-blocks/pro';
onEvent('input_toggleCamera', () => {});
onEvent('input_togglePause', () => {});
```

## Player Properties

All properties available on `physics.player` or `physics.getDynamicBody(index)`:

### Position & Rotation
| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `positionx/y/z` | Float64 | World position |
| `quaternionx/y/z/w` | Float32 | World rotation |
| `prevPositionx/y/z` | Float64 | Previous frame position (for interpolation) |

### Velocity
| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `localVelocityx/y/z` | Float32 | Body-local velocity |
| `externalVelocityx/y/z` | Float32 | World velocity (platforms) |

### Physics
| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| `mass` | Float32 | 1.5 | Body mass |
| `friction` | Float32 | 1 | Surface friction |
| `forceCapacity` | Float32 | 1 | Movement force multiplier |
| `turnCapacity` | Float32 | 2.1875 | Turn speed multiplier |
| `maxVelocity` | Int16 | 100 | Velocity cap |

### State Flags
| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `ground` | Int8 | Touching ground |
| `jumping` | Int8 | Currently jumping |
| `sleep` | Int8 | Physics sleeping |

### Input
| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `xAxisCtrl` | Float32 | Horizontal input (-1 to 1) |
| `yAxisCtrl` | Float32 | Vertical input (-1 to 1) |
| `move` | Int8 | Movement flag |
| `wishJump` | Int8 | Jump input |

### Gravity
| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `orbital` | Int8 | Enable orbital gravity |
| `magneticFeet` | Int8 | Align to surface |
| `attractorx/y/z` | Float32 | Gravity direction |

## Debug Visualization

### PhysicsDebug

3D billboarded text overlay displaying physics body state information.
Note: For dynamic/kinematic bodies, call `debug.update(renderer)` every frame to keep labels synced.

```javascript
import { PhysicsDebug } from '@three-blocks/pro';

const debug = new PhysicsDebug(physics, {
  yOffset: 2.0,           // Height offset above bodies
  fontSize: 0.15,         // Text font size
  updateInterval: 100,    // Content update interval (ms)
});
scene.add(debug);

// Optional: Initialize GPU culling for performance
debug.initCuller(renderer);

// Update in render loop
debug.update(renderer);

// Toggle visibility by body type
debug.setDynamicVisible(true);
debug.setKinematicVisible(true);
debug.setStaticVisible(false);

// Cleanup
debug.dispose();
```

**Displayed Information:**

| Body Type | Information |
|-----------|-------------|
| Dynamic | Position, Velocity, Mass, Friction, State flags |
| Kinematic | Position, Friction, Collision state |
| Static | Position (from mesh), Friction, Collision state |

**State Indicators:**
- `GND` - Grounded
- `MOV` - Moving
- `JMP` - Jumping
- `SLD` - Sliding
- `COL` - Colliding
- `WAL` - Hit wall

### PhysicsDebugBVH

BVH wireframe visualization for collision geometry.
Note: For dynamic/kinematic bodies, call `debugBVH.update()` every frame to keep transforms synced.

```javascript
import { PhysicsDebugBVH } from '@three-blocks/pro';

const debugBVH = new PhysicsDebugBVH(physics, {
  enabled: true,
  updateInterval: 250,
});
scene.add(debugBVH);

// Update in render loop
debugBVH.update();
```

## Syncing Physics to Meshes

Use `syncPhysics` to sync physics state to Three.js meshes with interpolation. Works for all body types.

```javascript
import { syncPhysics } from '@three-blocks/pro';

// Get interpolation alpha (0-1) for smooth rendering between physics frames
const alpha = controller.getInterpolationAlpha();

// Sync dynamic body (player)
syncPhysics(physics.player, playerMesh, alpha);

// Sync kinematic body (platform)
const kinematicState = physics.getKinematicBody(index);
syncPhysics(kinematicState, platformMesh, alpha);
```

**How it works:**
- Interpolates between previous and current physics frame positions
- Automatically falls back to direct position if prev values aren't available
- Provides smooth 60fps+ rendering even with fixed physics timestep

## Requirements

- **SharedArrayBuffer support** - Requires COOP/COEP headers:
  ```
  Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin
  Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: require-corp
  ```

- **Three.js** r182+
- **Modern browser** with Web Workers and Atomics support

## Complete Example

```javascript
import * as THREE from 'three/webgpu';
import {
  Physics,
  PhysicsController,
  PhysicsDebug,
  FirstPersonCamera,
  KinematicAnimator,
  BodyType,
  syncPhysics,
  BodyEvent
} from '@three-blocks/pro';

async function main() {
  // Scene setup
  const scene = new THREE.Scene();
  const renderer = new THREE.WebGPURenderer();
  renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
  document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

  // Physics
  const physics = new Physics({ gravity: -9.81, debug: true });
  await physics.init();

  // Ground
  const groundMesh = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.BoxGeometry(50, 1, 50),
    new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x444444 })
  );
  groundMesh.position.y = -0.5;
  scene.add(groundMesh);
  const groundApi = await physics.addBody(BodyType.STATIC, groundMesh, { friction: 1 });

  // Player
  const playerMesh = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.5, 1),
    new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x00ff88 })
  );
  playerMesh.position.set(0, 5, 0);
  scene.add(playerMesh);

  await physics.addBody(BodyType.DYNAMIC, playerMesh,
    { mass: 1.5, friction: 0.3 },
    { capsuleRadius: 0.5, capsuleLength: 1 }
  );

  // Moving platform (kinematic)
  const platformMesh = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.BoxGeometry(3, 0.5, 3),
    new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x6ad1ff })
  );
  platformMesh.position.set(5, 1, 0);
  scene.add(platformMesh);

  const platformApi = await physics.addBody(BodyType.KINEMATIC, platformMesh,
    { friction: 1 },
    {}
  );

  // Animate platform with KinematicAnimator
  const animator = new KinematicAnimator(physics);
  animator.animate(platformApi.index, {
    position: { from: [5, 1, 0], to: [10, 1, 0] },
    duration: 2000,
    ease: 'inOutQuad',
    loop: true,
    alternate: true,
  });

  // Configure player
  physics.player.forceCapacity = 12;
  physics.player.turnCapacity = 3;

  // Start physics
  await physics.start();

  // First-person camera - extends PerspectiveCamera
  const camera = new FirstPersonCamera(physics, {
    canvas: renderer.domElement,
    target: playerMesh,
    eyeHeight: 1.7,
    sensitivity: { x: 2, y: 2 },
    pitchLimits: [-85, 85],
    fov: 75,
  });

  // Controller with input handling
  const controller = new PhysicsController(physics, { enableInput: true });

  // Debug
  const debug = new PhysicsDebug(physics);
  scene.add(debug);

  // Lights
  scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.5));
  const dirLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1);
  dirLight.position.set(5, 10, 5);
  scene.add(dirLight);

  // Events - body events use addEventListener directly on the body
  groundApi.body.addEventListener(BodyEvent.COLLIDE, () => console.log('Hit ground'));

  // Render loop
  let lastTime = performance.now();
  function animate() {
    const now = performance.now();
    const delta = (now - lastTime) / 1000;
    lastTime = now;

    // Get input and apply to physics
    const input = controller.input.getInput();
    controller.applyInput(0, {
      x: input.x,
      y: input.y,
      jump: input.jump,
      // Note: Don't pass 'look' - FirstPersonCamera handles body rotation internally
    });
    controller.update(delta);

    // Get interpolation alpha for smooth rendering
    const alpha = controller.getInterpolationAlpha();

    // Sync player mesh with physics
    syncPhysics(physics.player, playerMesh, alpha);

    // Sync platform mesh with physics
    const platformState = physics.getKinematicBody(platformApi.index);
    syncPhysics(platformState, platformMesh, alpha);

    // Update camera and render
    camera.update(delta);
    debug.update(delta, renderer);
    renderer.render(scene, camera);  // Use camera directly!
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  }
  animate();

  // Cleanup
  window.addEventListener('beforeunload', () => {
    camera.dispose();
    animator.dispose();
    controller.dispose();
    physics.dispose();
  });
}

main();
```
